text:
mira: Heads-up: observed a tiny but deterministic corrupt token insertion when doing a hot-reload with rotary rescale on 4-shard runs. Happens only after ~60k tokens.

devon: can you paste the exact cmd + trigger?

mira: ./serve --model nebula20b --shards 4 --context 131072 --quant int4 --streaming 
# trigger: POST /admin/hot-reload {"quant":"int3"} at ~60k tokens

ash: short diff?

mira: pos: 59998 59999 60000
expected: ... 12 78 900
actual:   ... 12 78 1750 900
# one extra token 1750 inserted at 59999 then sequence realigns

devon: that pattern usually points to local_index aliasing on one shard during remap. Did you capture per-shard pos_base/stride?

mira: dumped metadata. shard2 had pos_base lagging by ~16 while others updated. dump: shard2 pos_base=59984, others=599...100.

ash: sounds like the hot-reload did remap and quant swap in parallel. We should add a short global barrier so all shards commit new pos_base/stride before accepting writes. Also add a write-time sanity check that rejects writes outside [pos_base, pos_base+capacity).

mira: agreed. opening an incident with repro + minimal dump. ci-bot: job 7012 flaked eng-ml/longctx-hotreload.

devon: plan: (1) add barrier + metrics for remap latency, (2) add guard in write path, (3) add integration that triggers hot-reload mid-stream with randomized token set for 100k tokens. I'll draft PR tomorrow.

ash: also include ROPE phase logs and a tiny rot-phase assert in the test to detect phase mismatch early.

mira: thanks — priority P2 for now; flagging for Dedicated longsession owners. :thumbsup:
